items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Bro? What city? New Orleans? ... I think so. You'd know him if you saw him.

ctx.x: Now another fellow... Did you ever know a fellow named Bro that played bass?
Well, he's from New Orleans, but he was with Duke Ellington for a while. And he traveled all over with Ellington. Bro, no.
